q: Choose the correct passive form: 'Why did your brother write such a letter?'
o: Why was such a letter written by your brother?
Why such a letter was written by your brother?
Why such a letter was written by your brother.
Why was such a letter been written by your brother?
e: Wh-প্রশ্নের passive-এ প্রশ্নবোধক শব্দ আগে বসে, তারপর auxiliary verb আর subject। Did write হলো past indefinite, তাই was + written। ফলে 'Why was such a letter written by your brother?'। অর্থ: তোমার ভাই এমন চিঠি কেন লিখেছিল? Auxiliary subject-এর আগে না বসালে প্রশ্নের শব্দক্রম ভাঙে। 'was ... been written' দুটি auxiliary হওয়ায় ভুল।

o: The newspaper was reading by him.
The newspaper has been read by him.

o: The freedom-fighters are always respected.

q: Who taught you Spanish? (make it passive)
o: By whom Spanish was taught you?
By whom were you taught Spanish?
By whom you were taught Spanish?

q: Who is looking after the child? (Make it passive.)
o: By whom is the child looked after?
By whom is the child being looked after?
By whom is being the child looked after?
By whom was the child being looked after?
e: Who দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া প্রশ্নের passive-এ বাক্য By whom দিয়ে শুরু হয়। বাক্যটি Present Continuous, তাই auxiliary হয় is being, এবং active-এর object the child হয় subject। এরপর মূল verb-এর past participle (looked) আর phrasal verb-এর অংশ after থেকে যায়। সঠিক রূপ: By whom is the child being looked after? Is being the child-এ ক্রম ভুল, was being অতীত কাল বোঝায়, আর is looked-এ continuous ভাব হারিয়ে যায়।

q: "The sudden noise frightened the horse." [সমাজসেবা অধিদপ্তরের সমাজকল্যাণ সংগঠন-০৫] Which is the correct passive form of the sentence?
o: The sudden horse frightened by the noise.
The noise frightened the horse suddenly.
The horse frightened the noise suddenly.
The horse was frightened by the sudden noise.

q: 'The cow gives us milk.'
o: We are being given milk by the cow
We were given milk by the cow
Milk is given to us by the cow
Milk is being given to us by the cow
e: মূল বাক্য Present Indefinite, তাই passive-এ is/are + V3 বসে। দুটি কর্ম থাকায় direct object (milk) কর্তা করলে indirect object-এর আগে to যোগ হয়: Milk is given to us by the cow। অর্থ: গরু আমাদের দুধ দেয়। being যুক্ত অপশনগুলো continuous আর were given অতীত কালের, তাই মেলে না।

q: They enjoyed themselves. (Make It Passive)
o: Themselves were enjoyed by them.
They were being enjoyed.
They are being enjoyed by themselves.
They were enjoyed by themselves.
e: বাক্যে reflexive pronoun (himself, themselves ইত্যাদি) থাকলে passive করার সময় active-এর subject অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। তার পর subject অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb, verb-এর past participle, by এবং reflexive object বসে। তাই They enjoyed themselves-এর passive They were enjoyed by themselves। আরও উদাহরণ: He killed himself হয়ে যায় He was killed by himself।
